mapper.select: select A.*, U.nickname as publisherName, U.username, R.nickname as runnerName, T.title, T.cover, T.pickup_address, T.delivery_address from b_order as A left join b_user as U on (A.publisher_id = U.id) left join b_user as R on (A.runner_id = R.id) left join b_task as T on (A.task_id = T.id) order by A.order_time desc;
